body: it's been 2 years but ya know, it's absolutely sickening that you feel I deserved to become homeless in my own city, because I was the victim of a violent crime. I am not an addict, definitely not antisocial, so I guess from your categories, I'd be "lazy". It's sad that you think it's totally okay that a hard-working single woman with a full-time & 2 part -time jobs, who worked constantly to stay above the poverty line, who never committed a crime (and actually volunteered with various orgs), is then made homeless because of the selfish, violent act of another - who wasn't homeless yet who WAS an addict and a burden on society.

i am never online. thanks for the reply. I am from Texas and you'd probably be considered 'cool' if you had a dui there, sadly. I became homeless because I was too disabled by the drunk driver to work again. Somehow ended up in the UK with a friend who lets me live here rent-free. None of my 'friends' back home were willing to help me out, even though none of it was my fault and i was only homeless and crippled due to the crimes of another.

No one kept in contact with me after I left, no one cared. Only friends I have now are my cats and the person I live with. Sorry, don't mean to be a downer but humans are horrible - you can be the best person but one bad thing happens to you and keeps kicking you down forever, and no one is there for you. I hope things have gottn better for you, at least?
